aiWorkflow.title: Context & Prompt Design
aiWorkflow.description: I engineer the context first — clear specs, examples, and constraints — so the model works from the same mental model I do. Good prompting is half the build.

aiWorkflow.title: AI Pair Programming
aiWorkflow.description: I build alongside Claude, Cursor, and Copilot in tight generate–refactor–review loops, while architecture and taste stay firmly human-owned.

aiWorkflow.title: RAG & Knowledge Grounding
aiWorkflow.description: For domain-heavy work I ground models in real data — docs, databases, embeddings — so answers are specific and verifiable, not generic.

aiWorkflow.title: Automation Pipelines
aiWorkflow.description: I wire multi-step agents and workflows in n8n and code, turning repetitive research, content, and ops work into reliable background jobs.

aiWorkflow.title: Evaluation & Guardrails
aiWorkflow.description: Every AI feature ships with checks — output validation, fallbacks, and human review on the paths that matter — so reliability isn't left to luck.

aiWorkflow.title: Ship, Measure, Iterate
aiWorkflow.description: I deploy, watch real usage, and tighten prompts, data, and UX until the feature is genuinely useful — not just a demo.
